newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Crown places shrs to raise A$81.9 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Crown places shrs to raise A$81.9 mln.

text.p: Melbourne casino operator Crown Ltd said it placed 32.75 million shares at A$2.50 each to raise A$81.88 million.
The placement, arranged by Prudential-Bache Securities (Australia) Ltd, represented 6.17 percent of the expanded capital of Crown, the company said.
The placement price compares with the market price of A$2.64 as 0305 GMT (2.05 p.m.)
Crown said its board considered the placement to be prudent at the current time.
"It will strengthen the company's balance sheet, improve the financing mix and further enhance capacity to consider appropriate opportunities," it said.
The new shares will rank equally with existing quoted shares as from their date of issue.
Crown also said its results for the first five months to November this year compared favourably with those a year earlier.
The Southbank project, the site of Crown's permanent casino, is proceeding satisfactorily and will be open in March next year, the company added.
